title: Discourse Connectors: Sequencing Ideas
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Los conectores del discurso te permiten estructurar tus ideas con claridad y profesionalismo, tanto al hablar como al escribir.

parts.visual: Conectores de secuencia: First (Primero), Then / Next (Luego / Después), After that (Después de eso), Finally / Lastly (Por último). Ejemplo: First, we analyzed the data. Then, we prepared the report.
parts.audio: Sequencing connectors: First, Then or Next, After that, Finally or Lastly. Example: First, we analyzed the data. Then, we prepared the report.

parts.visual: Conectores de adición: Also (También), In addition (Además), Furthermore (Es más / Además). Contraste: However (Sin embargo), But (Pero), On the other hand (Por otro lado). Resultado: Therefore (Por lo tanto), As a result (Como resultado).
parts.audio: Addition connectors: Also, In addition, Furthermore. Contrast: However, But, On the other hand. Result: Therefore, As a result.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el conector más apropiado para cada contexto.

questions.question: ____, we will review the budget. (Primero).
____, we will present the results. (Luego).
____, we will answer questions. (Por último).
____ that, we discussed the proposal. (Después de).
The project was successful. ____, costs were high. (Sin embargo).
Sales increased. ____, the team received a bonus. (Por lo tanto).
We finished on time. ____, we were under budget. (Además).
I like the proposal. ____ the timeline is too long. (Pero).
The product was good. ____, the price was too high. (Por otro lado).
questions.explanation: On the other hand = por otro lado.

questions.question: The deadline passed. ____, we lost the client. (Como resultado).
We need to reduce costs. ____, we need to increase revenue. (También).
____, I would like to thank the team. (Por último).
The numbers are good. ____, the trend is positive. (Es más).
____, we analyzed the data, ____ we wrote the report. (Primero... luego).
We had a problem. ____, we found a solution. (Sin embargo / pero).
The price is high. ____, the quality is excellent. (Sin embargo).
The team worked hard. ____, the project was completed on time. (Por lo tanto).
We have a strong team. ____, we have excellent technology. (Además).
____, I want to highlight one key point. (Para finalizar).
The meeting went well. ____, no decisions were made. (Sin embargo).
____, we reviewed the budget. (Primero).
____, we presented the results. (Luego).
____, we answered questions. (Por último).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
